clues.title: Cloned security keycard
clues.flavor: Dropped near a drain grate. The gallery's real keycards are white - this one's a cheap duplicate, the kind sold at any hardware kiosk.

clues.title: Tire tracks by the service door
clues.flavor: Narrow-set tread, consistent with a compact sedan. Elena Voss drives one just like it.

clues.title: Cigarette butts
clues.flavor: A specific menthol brand. Priya Anand smokes these on her breaks - she said she never left the front desk that night.

clues.title: Torn fabric on the fence
clues.flavor: A scrap of dark wool caught on the chain-link. Someone climbed over rather than through the gate.

clues.title: Spray-painted camera housing
clues.flavor: The lens is coated in black paint. Deliberate, and recent - the paint's still slightly tacky.

clues.title: Partial footprints in a puddle
clues.flavor: A woman's heel, mid-size. Heading toward the service door, not away from it.

clues.title: Pawn shop receipt, crumpled
clues.flavor: Priya Anand's name is on it. A loan against a watch, dated three weeks ago. Desperate, but not damning on its own.

clues.title: Trash bag
clues.flavor: Just kitchen waste from the cafe next door. Nothing here.

clues.title: Oil-slicked puddle
clues.flavor: Just runoff from a delivery van. Dead end.
